Topic: Ghidra Scalar Search Misses Constant-Pool Literals
Statement: On ARM, addresses that cannot be encoded as an immediate (such as 0xB1008000) are placed in the literal pool and loaded with LDR. Ghidra scalar search does not match those words. A negative scalar-search result is therefore not evidence of absence. This invalidated the "0 refs" conclusion in CONTRADICTION-USB-001 for nearly eight months.

Topic: Clean-Image Manifest Is Internally Inconsistent

The 256 MB figure comes from the FAT boot sector at 0x24007E00, not from the space actually available, which is 106921984 bytes. This is the same over-declaration that CL-STORAGE-REC-104 describes, and it means the January clean image was built on the three-volume model that finding-0010/0011 later refuted.

The document does not separate the two, so a reader inherits bench-level confidence for datasheet-level statements and vice versa.

Topic: Datasheet Cross-Check Of The Pin Table Is Incomplete
Statement: Spot checks against N3290X.PDF section 4.1 confirmed pins 57-60 (ADC_TP_YM/XM/XP/YP), 66, 79, 81 (GPD[0]/PWM0/TCK, i.e. backlight shares the pin with JTAG TCK), 86 (UD_CDET), 103, 116, 117 (GPE[10]/NALE, the encoder pin), 118 and 125-128 (GPB[5..2] I2S, the pogo header). Two entries could not be reproduced: pin 120 NCS0 and pin 122 URTXD -- the latter carries the claim that UART0 is blocked by the printhead. The datasheet table uses vertically centred cells without borders, and the automated extraction was only unambiguous where a cell holds a single signal row, so the remaining pins are not covered.
Next_Test: Write a parser that reconstructs the cell boundaries of N3290X.PDF section 4.1 (pages 20-32) and diff all 128 pins against the Rev 2.0 table. Settle pin 122 URTXD first, since the UART0-is-blocked claim rests on it.
